## SECTION 15 — Andhra Pradesh State Updates
The Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission (SEC) has immediately halted the ongoing election process for all 100 urban local bodies in the state, which includes 13 municipal corporations and 87 municipalities and nagar panchayats. This decision follows a Supreme Court order directing the SEC to postpone the publication of the final list of candidates, originally slated for October 21, until October 25. The Supreme Court also mandated the SEC to investigate representations, supporting material, and electronic evidence submitted by the YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) and other candidates, who alleged they were unable to file nominations due to law-and-order problems, including violence, threats, and intimidation. Furthermore, the Apex Court directed the SEC to decide by Thursday, October 22, whether to extend the last date for filing nominations in areas where candidates were prevented from doing so, with any extension to be for at least 48 hours. Allegations surfaced of YSRCP candidates being attacked and their nomination papers snatched in Macherla, Palnadu district, and former Deputy Chief Minister K Narayana Swamy was reportedly attacked in Chittoor during the local body election nomination process.
